title: Fake Gamemode
description: Fake Gamemode and Fake OP Commands for Pranking Friends!
body:
Fake Gamemode is a client-side Fabric mod that simulates Creative Mode and administrator commands without requiring actual server permissions. When using commands such as /gamemode creative, the mod changes the client interface to look like Creative Mode by hiding health and hunger bars. Commands appear available in chat, but no real server-side permissions are granted and no server actions are performed. Switching back with /gamemode survival restores the normal Survival HUD.

This mod is designed for fun and harmless pranks. You can make it look like you have operator permissions, surprise your friends, and pretend to use admin commands, while the server remains completely unaffected.
